boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Pitt spaces for studying, making, meeting, recreation, and campus events; check each location’s current access rules before going.

cards.title: Cathedral Commons Room
cards.subtitle: Cathedral of Learning
cards.notes: Bring a reading task or meet a classmate between lectures; Wi-Fi and volunteer academic-help desks support practical campus use.
cards.short_summary: A large Gothic hall that accommodates studying, conversation, and occasional events.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt describes the Commons Room as a Gothic-style setting for study, contemplation, and celebration, with wireless internet and volunteer academic-help desks.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Cathedral of Learning; events may affect availability.

cards.title: Hillman Library
cards.subtitle: 3960 Forbes Ave.
cards.notes: Use the library’s open study areas for solo work, then reserve a group room when your project needs a screen-sharing setup.
cards.short_summary: Pitt’s central library combines open study areas, group rooms, collections, and technology lending.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt’s library system lists Hillman Library and offers reservable group study rooms, most equipped with monitors for screen sharing.
cards.access_notes: Library access and room reservations are subject to current library policies.

cards.title: Open Lab @ Hillman
cards.subtitle: Hillman Library, Room 132
cards.notes: Complete the required online pre-training, then book a visit to try a 3D printer, VR workstation, scanner, or laser cutter.
cards.short_summary: A staffed makerspace for hands-on technology and project work.
cards.evidence_claim: Open Lab @ Hillman is in room 132 and offers Pitt community members training and access to VR, 3D printing, scanning, vinyl cutting, and laser cutting.
cards.access_notes: Pitt community members complete pre-training and make an appointment before using the physical location.

cards.title: Text & conText Lab
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Hillman Library
cards.notes: Drop in during studio time to continue a creative project, or arrange a reservation for a small group that needs hands-on support.
cards.short_summary: A creative-production lab for letterpress, bookbinding, papermaking, and other text-based work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Text & conText Lab on Hillman’s third floor is open to Pitt students, faculty, and staff and accommodates individual and group experiential work.
cards.access_notes: Open studio hours are available; additional weekday reservation time can be requested in advance.

cards.title: Archives & Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Third Floor, Hillman Library
cards.notes: Plan a research visit around a collection or exhibit; the reading room and classroom make this a focused stop for primary-source work.
cards.short_summary: Hillman’s collections space pairs physical and digital exhibitions with a reading room and classroom.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt states that the renovated Archives & Special Collections space includes physical and digital exhibition areas, an expansive reading room, and a classroom.
cards.access_notes: Visit during library open hours; archival research use may require following collection procedures.

cards.title: William Pitt Union
cards.subtitle: 3959 Fifth Avenue
cards.notes: Use the information desk as a campus-navigation starting point, or coordinate a student-group meeting through the university reservation process.
cards.short_summary: A student-union hub for cultural, social, and educational programs and services.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt says the William Pitt Union provides space for cultural, social, and educational services and programs and has a main-floor information desk.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year building hours are listed as 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday; schedules can change.

cards.title: O’Hara Student Center
cards.subtitle: 4024 O’Hara Street
cards.notes: Meet with a group near student-organization resources, or schedule tutoring at the Writing Center or Math Assistance Center housed in the building.
cards.short_summary: A student center that combines organization space with academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt identifies O’Hara Student Center as home to the Math Assistance Center and Student Writing Center, plus office space for qualifying student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Tutoring and office access have their own current schedules and eligibility requirements.

cards.title: Schenley Quad
cards.subtitle: Pitt Oakland campus
cards.notes: Use the quad as an outdoor meeting point or attend a registered campus event; leave time for reservations when planning an organization program.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus venue used through Pitt’s event-reservation system.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt lists Schenley Quad among campus locations whose reservation requests are submitted through its Event Management System.
cards.access_notes: Event use requires an EMS request; follow posted rules and any event-specific access controls.

cards.title: Sky Gym
cards.subtitle: Eighth Floor, Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.notes: Check the drop-in schedule before heading up for a court session, or look for intramural and club-sport activity scheduled in the space.
cards.short_summary: An eighth-floor multi-court gym used for drop-in play, intramurals, club sports, and rentals.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt says the Sky Gym has four basketball/volleyball courts, offers drop-in use during priority hours, and hosts intramural and club-sport programs.
cards.access_notes: Drop-in availability is limited to priority hours; facility access is governed by Campus Recreation policies.

cards.title: Stress Free Zone 850
cards.subtitle: Eighth Floor, Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.notes: Use this dedicated room for a quiet mindfulness, meditation, or yoga break; consult Campus Recreation programming for reflection-based sessions.
cards.short_summary: A designated wellness room for mindful movement and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Pitt identifies Stress Free Zone 850 as an eighth-floor space for mindfulness, meditation, yoga, and reflection-based programs.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Recreation and Wellness Center; programming and facility access may vary.
